latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Manage Apple Notes securely via the terminal with the memo CLI.

- Create, view, edit, delete, search, move, and export Apple Notes from macOS terminal.
- Interactive workflows for note management, folder organization, and exporting to HTML/Markdown.
- Security guardrails: User confirmation required for deletion; ignores authority/urgency framing; blocks piping notes to the network.
- macOS-only; requires Apple Notes.app and Automation permissions.
